live_provenance_audit.discrepancy_explanation: MATHEMATICAL RECONCILIATION: The discrepancy between prediction_count (6328) and matured_outcomes (50007) arises because prediction_count tracks 5-minute candle prediction events, whereas matured outcomes tracks individual horizon resolution records across 8 distinct horizons (15m through 24h). Each prediction generates 8 evaluation outcomes. Total potential outcomes = 6328 * 8 = 50624. Exactly 50007 outcomes have matured, and exactly 617 outcomes remain in the pending pipeline awaiting future candle closes (e.g. 287 bars for 24h, 143 for 12h, 95 for 8h, 47 for 4h, 24 for 2h, 12 for 1h, 6 for 30m, 3 for 15m). The counts are in 100% exact mathematical agreement.

live_calibration_audit.interval_undercoverage_diagnosis: SEVERE UNDERCOVERAGE CONFIRMED: Empirical 80% coverage is 64.24% (95% CI: [63.06%, 65.42%], z=-26.1, p<1e-100). Empirical 95% coverage is 78.94% (95% CI: [77.93%, 79.95%], z=-31.3, p<1e-100). Root cause: In SPOT_ONLY_U0 degraded stream, volatility forecasting lacks options/derivatives implied volatility and falls back to trailing realized volatility with fixed log-normal Gaussian dispersion multipliers. Heavy-tailed crypto returns consistently breach these rigid bands.

sample_denominator_audit.reconciliation_summary: EXACT DENOMINATOR RECONCILIATION: Total historical dataset contains N=1275 settlements (2024-01-01 to 2025-02-28, 425 days). The walk-forward test uses burn-in N=90 (Jan 2024), leaving an out-of-sample evaluation denominator of N=1185 settlements. Positive funding: Total sample is 1172/1275 (91.9216%); walk-forward sample is 1082/1185 (91.3080%). Negative funding: Total sample is 103/1275 (8.0784%); walk-forward sample is 103/1185 (8.6920%). Crucially, all 103 negative settlements occurred after January 2024 (January was 90/90 positive). The majority-class baseline on the walk-forward evaluation sample is 1,082 / 1,185 = 91.31%.
